fresh_research.oracle: Python unbounded integers; explicit raw64 two-complement interpretation. No CUDA shuffle/tree simulation; raw unsigned word packing only after mathematical result.
fresh_research.controls: Each signedness and all patterns/masks run NVRTC O3 and direct O0/O3. producer_consumer_trace: hlsl.meta.slang WaveMultiPrefixInclusive/ExclusiveMin/Max scalar/vector CUDA branches produce exact GenericAsm helper spelling. WaveMultiMin/Max additionally admits matrix overloads; CUDA prelude uses ElementTypeTrait for leaves.

NVRTC prelude defines int64_t/longlong as long long and uint64_t/ulonglong as unsigned long long. WaveOpMin/Max compare same T and select T; no narrow integer promotion, float conversion or arithmetic overflow. Exclusive identities are explicit64-bit extrema. Inclusive/reduction seeds duplicate selected inputs, harmless for integer extrema.

_resolveNVVMMaskedWaveScalarOperation and _resolveNVVMAggregateWaveOperation reach _initializeNVVMMaskedWaveScalarOperation, then _getNVVMMaskedWaveScalarIdentity rejects integer64 before typed admission. Scalar T(T,uint4), vectors and matrix Array<vector<T,2>,2>/OutParam forms are canonical allowed source shapes.

Catalog signed/unsignedI64 WAVE_READ_LANE_AT and parameterized integer MIN/MAX/SELECT are admitted. Provider _emitWaveReadLaneAt extracts low/high32, shuffles with same mask/lane/clamp31, ORs both i64 halves. IntegerBinary selects SLT/ULT/SGT/UGT, preserving full operands.

Provider _getIntegerConstant accepts signed int64 argument and ConstantInt::getSigned preserves its bits. Canonical UInt64 literals already store high-bit payload in signed IRIntegerValue; _asExecutableSelectedIntegerConstant admits width64. Runtime control constants verify zero, signed max/min and all ones in source and direct modes.
